versions.content: Textually formulated content attached to DiagnosticTrou- bleCode The definition of a DiagnosticTroubleCode also consists of textually formulated content that is formalized in structure but cannot be formalized in content. The purpose of this content is to define e.g. an error text or the possible cause that relates to the specific DiagnosticTroubleCode .
